name: repo-owasp-benchmark
description: OWASP Benchmark v1.2 — the neutral SAST leaderboard (2,740 Java cases), scored per-CWE Youden. Run it with `scripts/bench-box.sh sast`, which clones OWASP-Benchmark/BenchmarkJava and invokes `tsbench sast --target <tree> --ground-truth expectedresults-1.2.csv` (the scorer consumes upstream's CSV verbatim). Pure static analysis — nothing is executed — so this is the safest target in the benchmark set. Kept runnable:false because it is scored by `tsbench sast`, not by `tsbench run --fixture`.

competitors.note: Per-CWE Youden index against OWASP Benchmark v1.2. Both original blockers are CLOSED — semgrep is wrapped and sits in the repository asset's anchor list (internal/asset/repository/handler.go), and repo source-tree mounting works (fixtures/repo/sca-vuln is runnable proof). What remains is fetching the 2,740-case corpus, which scripts/bench-box.sh does. DAST tools on the same corpus (ZAP 13%) are NOT the SAST comparison — see CLAUDE.md §6.1.1.
